sample_unit: treatment plans (six patients, three planning approaches)
unlisted_practices: Automated radiation treatment planning tool for resource-constrained (LMIC) settings, with autocontouring verification and physician review of plan acceptability

screen.reason: The study develops and tests an autoplanning and autocontouring tool for pediatric craniospinal irradiation using retrospective patient CT scans and expert clinician acceptability ratings, without testing a specific implementation safeguard or deployment practice.
